address: 2 rue du Maréchal-Foch, à Fourqueux, Saint-Germain-en-Laye, 78112, France
bio: Fulcosa means fern in Latin, a reference to the plant that once carpeted the surrounding forests, suggesting that the young proprietors have a sense of history as well as flavours! In the inviting decor of their culinary bistro, they treat us to tasty seasonal cuisine in which tradition meets innovation: for example, mushroom ravioli in a chicken broth, with bacon and hazelnut....
